snippet.title: Airship 2: Kingdoms Ablaze Game Reveal Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
A sequel to Airship: Kingdoms Adrift. Command fleets in tactical aerial battles, build trade and industrial networks, and shape diplomacy in this skypunk action simulation strategy game where rival powers clash for control of the skies.

Wishlist us on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4262710/Airship_2_Kingdoms_Ablaze/
